items.title: IRS online services spotlight: Taxpayers can get more done online
items.summary: The Internal Revenue Service encouraged taxpayers to explore IRS.gov online tools that can help them quickly and securely take care of common tax tasks.

items.title: IRS reminder: Extension filers can use IRS Free File this summer
items.summary: The Internal Revenue Service encouraged taxpayers who requested an extension to file their 2025 federal tax return as soon as possible.

items.title: IRS CEO meets with tax professionals at NY tax forum
items.summary: The Internal Revenue Service reported on its engagement with taxpayers and representatives at the IRS Nationwide Tax Forum in New York.

items.title: IRS reminder: Information return e-file system transitioning to a new platform
items.summary: The IRS reminded information return filers to prepare for the FIRE system retirement and transition to IRIS before the 2027 filing season.

items.title: Interest rates remain the same for the fourth quarter of 2026
items.summary: The Internal Revenue Service announced that interest rates will remain unchanged for the calendar quarter beginning Oct. 1, 2026.

items.title: IRS launches digitally authenticated Tax Compliance Report
items.summary: The Internal Revenue Service announced a digitally authenticated Tax Compliance Report available through IRS Individual Online Account.
